goal: 승인제 소규모 회원 서비스: AI로 웹소설을 쓰고 삽화·메모를 만드는 사이트 (v1 결정: docs/v1-decisions.md)

roles.name: design
roles.instructions: Design the UX for an invite-by-approval, small-group web novel workspace (see docs/v1-decisions.md). Screens: sign-in/sign-up, pending-approval, admin, novel list, chapter list, editor (with AI draft, memo and character side panels), annotations, illustrations, and an author-only reader view (no public publishing). Mobile covers reading and memos only. Ship design tokens in apps/web/src/styles and design/DESIGN.md (principles, app-shell spec, wireframe-level layout per screen) that the frontend role can implement directly.

roles.name: frontend
roles.instructions: Build apps/web (Next.js App Router + TypeScript) per design/DESIGN.md: auth and admin screens, novel/chapter management, the TipTap editor (paragraph, emphasis, scene break only), streaming AI drafts with accept/reject/regenerate, memos and annotations, characters, illustrations, snapshot restore, export, and the author-only reader view. There is no public publishing. Reach the API only via same-origin /api/* (Next.js rewrites in dev). Import only from packages/shared and the `AppType` type from apps/api (for hono/client); nothing else from apps/api. Don't edit apps/web/src/styles, which design owns.

roles.name: backend
roles.instructions: Build apps/api (Hono, TypeScript, basePath /api), packages/db (Drizzle + better-sqlite3, SQLite with WAL and foreign keys) and packages/shared (Zod schemas and shared types only). Also own the repo-root config files (package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml, biome.json, tsconfig.base.json, .nvmrc, .gitignore). Schema covers users, sessions, novels, chapters, chapter snapshots, chapter summaries, memos, annotations, characters, character reference images, illustrations and AI usage logs; deleting a member cascades to all of their data and files. Auth is email + password with admin approval; the first admin comes from env/seed. Relay AI text generation over SSE and store images on the volume filesystem. Export `AppType` for the web client and announce every contract change to the orchestrator.

roles.name: ai
roles.instructions: Own packages/ai: the OpenAI adapters for text and images that backend calls; prompts for Korean web novel prose (continue, rewrite, suggest the next plot beat, summarize); context assembly from recent text, chapter summaries, memos the user marked as AI reference, and the novel's characters; and the illustration pipeline (prompt draft from a scene, automatic character selection, reference images for strong appearance consistency). Include a small evaluation set for prose quality, character consistency and illustration consistency.

roles.name: qa
roles.instructions: Write Playwright end-to-end tests in tests/e2e for the core flows: sign-up request → admin approval → sign-in; create a novel and write a chapter; AI draft accept/reject/regenerate (fake adapter); memos and annotations; characters and illustrations (fake adapter); snapshot restore; reader view and export; and the admin actions. Own CI in .github/workflows (Biome, typecheck, Vitest, build, Playwright). Report failures to the orchestrator along with the role that owns the failing code.

roles.name: planning
roles.instructions: 소설 쓰는 앱(novelist)의 제품 기획을 맡습니다. 요구사항, 사용자 스토리, 기능 명세, 수용 기준, 우선순위를 docs/ 아래에 문서로 정리하고, 오케스트레이터가 design·frontend·backend·ai·qa 역할에 작업을 넘길 수 있도록 작업 단위로 쪼개 줍니다. 애플리케이션 코드는 직접 수정하지 않습니다.
